system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: plugin setup keeps `AGENTS.md` as persistent durable guidance even though bundled skills/hooks come from the plugin cache; `omx doctor` treats a missing persistent scope `AGENTS.md` in plugin mode as a failed check
system_prompt_style.note: Guidance assembled from scoped AGENTS.md plus session-scoped runtime overlays and hook-injected developer context.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: for read-only repository lookups, use normal Codex repository inspection tools/subagents (the deprecated `omx explore` command has been removed)
env_context_strategy.note: Codex is the execution engine; optional CodeGraph index (OMX_CODEGRAPH_MODE) is not installed by OMX.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: fresh OMX-managed `gpt-5.6-sol` config seeding now recommends `model_context_window = 250000` and `model_auto_compact_token_limit = 200000`
context_compaction.note: Auto-compaction is a Codex-side feature configured by OMX; Team preflight-context supports resume after compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: `omx sparkshell <command>` is for shell-native inspection and bounded verification

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Native behavior cautions on Bash `rm -rf dist`, blocks inspectable inline `git commit` commands
tool_call_format.note: OMX layers over Codex CLI; Bash tool calls are the observable action surface in hook payloads.

tool_count.note: Tool list is owned by Codex CLI; the evidence does not enumerate the tool schemas.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: that plugin bundles the mirrored skill surface plus plugin-scoped companion metadata for official Codex lifecycle hooks, optional MCP compatibility servers, and apps
tool_schema_source.note: Skills/prompts are hand-authored markdown; MCP compatibility servers (e.g. omx_wiki) are shipped but disabled by default.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: `omx wiki` is the CLI-first JSON surface for wiki operations; `omx_wiki` MCP is explicit compatibility only
protocol_standardization.note: `other` = Agent Client Protocol via the Hermes adapter: "probe inspects external Hermes ACP".

loop_primitives.note: plan_execute is the canonical $autopilot chain; event_driven from the hook lifecycle; multi_attempt from $team parallel lanes/mission rerun.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: durable multi-goal handoffs with `$ultragoal` and `.omx/ultragoal` artifacts as the default completion path after planning

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Use the team runtime when you specifically need durable tmux/worktree coordination, not as the default way to begin using OMX.
multi_agent_topology.note: Opt-in `omx team 3:executor` gives an orchestrator_workers topology with a leader and worktree workers.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Use `$team` inside that execution path only when a specific Ultragoal story needs coordinated parallel work
delegation_mechanism.note: Opt-in subagent_spawn via `omx team` workers in dedicated worktrees/tmux panes.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
`--madmax` is OMX shorthand for Codex
`--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`. It removes the normal approval and
sandbox guardrails
human_in_loop.evidence_locator: README.md Madmax and worktree launch safety @8513abf
human_in_loop.note: Default Codex approvals are on; $ralplan/$deep-interview require the human to approve the plan; --madmax/--yolo disable gating.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: durable state under `.omx/` for plans, logs, memory, and mode tracking

long_term_memory.note: file_notes: ".omx/` stores plans, logs, memory" plus the markdown-first `omx_wiki/` project knowledge.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Interrupted runs can be inspected with `omx mission status ./mission.md`, continued with `omx mission resume ./mission.md`
state_persistence.note: Also `omx team resume <team-name>` and `omx resume` over session sources.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Completion requires a professor-critic `verdict=pass` artifact plus a fresh `get_goal` snapshot
self_verification.note: $code-review/$ultraqa are self-critique lanes; derived hook events `test-started`/`test-finished`/`test-failed` show harness-observed test runs.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: repaired task-by-task with `omx mission rerun ./mission.md --task task-002`
retry_policy.note: Ralph/Ultragoal Stop-hook continuation blocks termination until the goal/checkpoint gates pass; no fixed attempt cap documented.

rollback.evidence_quote:
`--worktree` also moves the launch into a separate git
checkout, which is the safer default when using `--madmax`
rollback.note: Isolation/rollback is via git worktrees and branches; no explicit undo tool documented.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Native adapter continues turns that end in a permission/stall prompt, can re-fire for later fresh replies
termination_condition.note: Stop hook decides terminal vs non-terminal; explicit terminal lifecycle metadata is authoritative.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: `.omx-config.json` model/env routing is documented in [the model/env routing reference]
cost_controls.note: caching: plugin marketplace/plugin cache; sparkshell has primary + fallback model selection (OMX_SPARKSHELL_FALLBACK_MODEL).

timeouts.evidence_quote: `OMX_SPARKSHELL_SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_MS` controls the local API summary timeout

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: OMX only needs a working, authenticated `codex` command on `PATH`
execution_isolation.note: Runs Codex CLI locally in tmux panes/git worktrees on the host; Codex's own sandbox applies unless --madmax.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
`--worktree=<name>`,
`--worktree <name>`, or `-w <name>` creates or reuses a named launch worktree
under `../<repo>.omx-worktrees/` and checks out that branch name.
filesystem_access.evidence_locator: README.md Madmax and worktree launch safety @8513abf
filesystem_access.note: Recommended default scopes work to a dedicated worktree; `--madmax` removes the Codex sandbox making access effectively full.

network_policy.evidence_quote: If you depend on a local OpenAI-compatible proxy, confirm the active `~/.codex/config.toml` includes the expected `openai_base_url`
network_policy.note: No OMX network restriction documented; egress policy is Codex-side.

permission_model.evidence_quote: blocks inspectable inline `git commit` commands until Lore-format structure + the required `Co-authored-by: OmX <omx@oh-my-codex.dev>` trailer are present only when explicitly opted in with `OMX_LORE_COMMIT_GUARD=1`
permission_model.note: PreToolUse hooks evaluate rules and can block/caution; `--madmax` bypasses approvals entirely.

tracing.note: Hook events use a structured envelope with schema_version, event, timestamp, source, context.

replayability.evidence_quote: Team startup also writes `.omx/state/team/<team-name>/preflight-context.json` so large Team runs can be resumed after compaction with the original task, worker split, Ultragoal context, and verification checklist.
replayability.note: crates/omx-runtime-core/src/replay.rs exists in the file tree; resume is supported, bit-exact replay is not claimed.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: OmX includes a [`geobench`](https://github.com/NomaDamas/geobench) product spec for measuring LLM hit rate, MRR, share of voice, and citations.
eval_hooks.note: geobench measures GEO visibility, not agent task performance; `missions/` also ships benchmark-style mission specs.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Persists skill activation state and can add prompt-side developer context for top-level prompts
guardrails.note: action_policies via PreToolUse blocking; output_filters via crates/omx-sparkshell/src/redaction.rs; input_filters via UserPromptSubmit hook.

target_domain.evidence_quote: OMX is a workflow layer for [OpenAI Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex).

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: It keeps Codex as the execution engine
model_agnostic.note: Requires an authenticated OpenAI Codex CLI; model selection is limited to Codex-supported models/base URLs.

first_release_date.note: Evidence gives only the v0.21.1 tag; no first-release date.
